phrase.zh: 感知的强度，也可以成为颜色。
phrase.en: Intensity of perception can become color.

visual.zh: 向日葵、旋动的笔触意象与梵高的生成肖像组成致意。它不是梵高原作或遗失作品，画面借熟悉的花与色彩讨论感受如何进入绘画。
visual.en: Sunflowers, swirling marks and a generated portrait form a tribute to Van Gogh. This is not an original or lost work by him; familiar flowers and color suggest feeling entering a painting.

background.zh: 梵高博物馆的研究区分了不同《向日葵》版本：阿姆斯特丹藏本绘于 1889 年 1 月，以前一年夏天的静物为依据。反复画同一主题并不只是复制，版本之间的材料、构图和保存状况也都值得分别研究。
background.en: The Van Gogh Museum distinguishes versions of Sunflowers: its Amsterdam painting dates to January 1889 and draws on the previous summer’s still life. Reworking a subject is not merely duplication; versions have individual compositions, materials and conservation histories.
